explication: Spotifast is a native Rust Spotify client. The main workflow starts with a user browsing or searching the catalogue, selecting music, and controlling playback in the app; playback can run locally or on another Spotify Connect device. The graph preserves major README capabilities—library and playlist management, radio, lyrics, visualizers, classic skins, link handling, and device discovery—without implying unsampled internal call chains. The tree and excerpts support the named modules, while several subsystem connections are based on documented product behavior.
